sections.content: Report from dashboard: SQL injection -order / Group by. Generated automatically by DBDOME.

sections.query:
select distinct server , query , to_timeStamp(creation_time::bigint/1000) last_request_end_time , avg_elapsed_time duration 
FROM monitoring.expensive_queries  where query   ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%ORDER BY 1%', '%ORDER BY%2'])
